project_type: Next.js 16.2.6 App Router SaaS (WhatsApp CRM) with Supabase (Postgres, service-role server access), Razorpay Subscriptions billing in src/lib/billing/razorpay
language: TypeScript (React 19 client components, Node route handlers)
build_system: npm + next build. NEVER run next build without NEXT_DIST_DIR (shares .next with the dev server). Use $env:NEXT_DIST_DIR=".next-verify3"; npm run build, then git checkout -- tsconfig.json and Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .next-verify3. next.config.js/.mjs must never exist.
test_framework: vitest (node environment, include src/**/*.test.ts(x)); component tests use react-dom/server renderToStaticMarkup (see src/components/settings/autopay-card.test.tsx)
verification_instructions: 1) npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | Select-String "error TS" (only src/ errors count; .next/dev/types noise is not ours). 2) npx vitest run (baseline 198 files / 2,467 tests, all green). 3) npx eslint <touched paths> (3 pre-existing no-explicit-any errors in src/components/settings/whatsapp-setup.tsx are not ours). 4) npx prettier --write <touched paths>, then git diff --stat and git checkout -- any file you did not intend to touch. 5) build as above, then git checkout -- tsconfig.json and delete .next-verify3.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. next build rewrites tsconfig.json: always git checkout -- tsconfig.json afterwards.

contribution_requirements: AGENTS.md: read node_modules/next/dist/docs before Next-specific code (route handlers: 01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/route.md, params is a Promise; after(): 04-functions/after.md). Surface real errors, never substitute plausible values. Copy: plain prose, no exclamation marks, no em dashes. Permanent unit tests ARE wanted for this task (user accepted D11). Light-only slate palette in super-admin. Prettier reformats whole files that were never clean: mention it in the summary.
key_patterns: Super-admin routes: const sa = await requireSuperAdmin(request) (src/lib/super-admin/guard.ts) first, catch with superAdminErrorResponse(err); POSTs check isSameOrigin(request) from @/lib/http/request-origin; rate limit with checkRateLimit(key,{limit,windowMs})/rateLimitResponse from @/lib/rate-limit; Cache-Control no-store. Billing wiring: getBillingDeps() (runtime.ts, throws RazorpayConfigError -> 503) / getEventDeps() (jobs.ts) / getRazorpayConfig() (null when unconfigured); errors via toRazorpayErrorResponse(err, ctx). Razorpay tolerated errors: err instanceof RazorpayApiError && (err.isAlreadyInState || err.isNotFound). Cancel pattern: lifecycle.ts cancelAutopay (cancelSubscription(pid,false) -> db.markCancelRequested(id, actor) -> syncSubscription(deps,pid,source)). Status is only ever written from a fresh Razorpay fetch through billing_apply_subscription_snapshot. subscription_events.source CHECK allows customer|admin|razorpay_webhook|reconciliation|checkout|system. Password re-check + 2FA pattern: src/app/api/super-admin/accounts/[id]/delete/verify/route.ts using verifyPassword (account-deletion.ts) and hasActiveTwoFactor/verifyUserTotp (@/lib/two-factor/server). Test fakes: src/lib/billing/razorpay/__fixtures__/factories.ts (makeDb, makeClient, makeConfig, makeRow, makeRazorpaySubscription) and phase3.ts (makeStore, makeEventDeps). Route test mocking pattern: src/app/api/billing/razorpay/routes.test.ts (hoisted env, next/server after collector, runtime getBillingDeps mock) and src/app/api/super-admin/accounts/[id]/delete-account.test.ts (guard mock, chainable supabaseAdmin fake, @supabase/supabase-js createClient password fake, two-factor mock). URL tab state: useSearchParams under Suspense + replaceSearchParams (src/lib/url-state.ts), see src/app/(dashboard)/settings/page.tsx. Table/filters/pagination markup: PaymentRequestsPanel in src/app/(super-admin)/super-admin/payments/page.tsx. Money: fromMinor (money.ts) + formatCurrency (@/lib/currency).
directory_structure: src/lib/billing/razorpay: server billing library (client, db/store wrappers over SECURITY DEFINER SQL, service/events/reconcile/lifecycle logic, pure view/mapping). src/app/api/billing: customer billing routes (ungated in src/proxy.ts). src/app/api/super-admin: operator routes (ungated, requireSuperAdmin). src/app/(super-admin)/super-admin: operator pages. src/components/super-admin/billing: payments page panels. supabase/migrations: additive SQL, newest razorpay file 20261023010000_razorpay_billing_method_summary.sql, next is 20261024000000_razorpay_billing_phase5.sql. docs/razopay: plan and phase reports. scratch/: gitignored throwaway scripts.
